# Staged incoming-helper bases on the pinned PR3133 word

This is a finite exact local construction. It keeps helpers 644 and 660 and
changes each ordinary helper width 8 to 7. It does **not** supply the originally
requested width 7 to 6 extraction, a chronological owner allocation, or a new κ.
Those distinctions matter: the successful construction uses direct inverse
cleanup on ordinary FULL-ended helpers rather than declaring a new cold helper.

The sole word input is PR3133 commit
`51eb9c4ee9e4722010d308aa3309e039d3940cc2`, directory
`research/rank7-coupled-586-588-carrier-fold/edits/FINAL-WORD-{base,extra}.json.gz`.
The frozen outputs are `STAGED644-660-{base,extra}.json.gz`. Their compressed
SHA256 values are respectively
`735c540b1fe29d0ceeb4d2f304ec941e5f2bd3bc92bafc8cce2b4f9a67a3b653` and
`886338fc32da14f3389a82c8120a1bcf9c5e2f0ec3e9b2d377fdae809e1d977f`.

## Contract and changed premise

Work over exact dyadic Gaussian coefficients; the free-operator audit works
over rational coefficients with independent invertible warp symbols. Every
one of the 632 remaining source, target and helper inputs is arbitrary and
independent. There are 408 helper roles and 91 explicitly zero private cleanup
buffers. The old removed-register set, source ports, targets, centre cut,
native warp matrices/charts, target compensation and operator corrections
are unchanged. Each completed local map is `y_t += x_t`, with every other
input restored and every private buffer zero, in both orientations.

Write `L=span_F2{30}`, `P=span_F2{429,30}`, and `F=F_2^9`. Their ranks are 1,2,9.
Both affected helpers originally enter at L and end at F. They now enter at P
and still end at F. A nonzero frame is never treated as a zero value.

The earlier 511-line common-release obstruction excluded existing entering
helpers and fixed the positive word. Here all six coordinates are existing
nonzero-entry, nonrestored helpers, and eight early target contacts are
changed. Thus that earlier obstruction does not cover this construction.
The old fixed factory endpoint/source 47/429 or 21/53 substitution arguments
also retain different input coordinates, scalar words and source contracts.
No true source input is mixed here.

## Two exact prefix directions

Let `e_j` denote a helper input coordinate and put

```
w1 =  2 e640 - 2 e496,       S1 = I + w1 e644*,
w2 = -  e656 - 2 e520,       S2 = I + w2 e660*.
v1 = e644 + w1,             v2 = e660 + w2.
```

All six supports are disjoint between the two changes. Within either change,
the pivot is absent from w, so `S_i^-1 = I - w_i e_h*`. Also `S1 S2=S2 S1`.
All six helpers have entryL, endF, noA contact, no initial operator correction,
and zero columns in the inherited target compensation C. Consequently
`C S1 S2=C`, and the initial correction source set is unchanged.

The early target-column tables, with omitted entries zero, are:

| target register | column644 | column640 | column496 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
|135|1/2|-1/4|0|
|146|-1/2|1/4|0|
|162|1/2|-1/4|0|
|220|1/2|1/4|1/2|

| target register | column660 | column656 | column520 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
|141|1/2|1/2|0|
|171|1/2|-1/2|1/2|
|185|-1/2|-1/2|0|
|196|1/2|1/2|0|

Each table kills its displayed v exactly. These are dirty-input columns,
including lender dirt; no clean-source projection was used.

Delete old B184..187, which are the four raw 644 target writes, and old B216..219,
the four raw 660 target writes. Before old B599 emit, at P,

```
640 += 2*644
496 -= 2*644
```

Before old B647 emit, also at P,

```
656 -= 660
520 -= 2*660
```

The helpers carrying these releases retain their old values until their
respective first actual producers. The tables therefore show that deleting
the pivot target columns and then making the release implements the old
prefix times S. `check_scope.py` independently propagates the six affected arbitrary input
columns through the prefix and checks `P_new=P_old S1 S2` before old B647.
It verifies that these coordinates have no earlier A or compensation contact
and that no nonzero affected column crosses a native warp. Every other column
is unchanged by the displayed edits, giving the full prefix identity. The
separate inherited auditor checks the completed map on every arbitrary input. The input S in this
factorization is algebraic; no additional zero-frame S gate is silently charged
as free. Its physical implementation is the displayed changed word.

The old completed target shear annihilates every helper input. Hence right
multiplication by these helper-only S matrices preserves the original external
source-to-target map. In particular, this proof does not use the invalid rule
that `C S` alone preserves a changed true-source basis.

## Terminal and inverse cleanup

Let M be the old non-target forward operator before FULL cleanup. The changed
forward operator is `M S1 S2`. Every old restored-helper row and column stays
the literal identity: the supports of S1,S2 are disjoint from all 91 restored
input coordinates, and the corresponding old M rows/columns are isolated.
Thus the old private-buffer namespace and its entrance-zero contract survive.

The six changed coordinates are ordinary FULL-ended helpers. Cleanup may read
their real registers; it is regenerated as the literal inverse of the complete
changed non-target forward word, including inverse warps and the inherited
zero-buffer substitution for the 91 cold helpers. It restores every non-target input and clears every private buffer; the targets retain the specified shear.
No new precleanup row/column isolation is asserted for 644 or 660. Isolation is
checked for every old cold helper before cleanup, and for all coordinates at
the completed boundary. This is why no extra private buffer is required.

The actual physical helper residual is the paired operator

```
T_F T_P^-1,
L_wrapper^-1 T_F T_P^-1 R_wrapper^-1 = C_[7] tensor I_[2].
```

`check_residual.py` verifies all 512 Gaussian columns including global phase,
using independently decoded monomial recipes. It rejects the old rank 8 wrapper,
a changed global phase, and omission of the entrance transform. The same-order
dual identity is its exact inverse transpose.

## Complete local invoice and frame legality

The common frame P is contained in both relevant first-body frames. For 644:
donor 496 first reaches `span(385,44,30)` of rank 3, and 640/644 first reach
`span(423,65,20,10)` of rank 4. For 660 the corresponding frames are
`span(429,70,30)` and `span(427,96,24,6)`. These contain P exactly. No frame is
inferred merely from dimension. Every full changed monotone chain is separately
checked by native transport and independent local replay.

Per pivot, the changed climb histograms are

```
pivot:       H2 - H3
first donor: H1 + H2 - H3
second donor:2 H1 - H2
total:       3 H1 + H2 - 2 H3.
```

Their disjoint combination gives

```
old L = {1:2433,2:724,3:228,4:102,5:20,8:8}
new L = {1:2439,2:726,3:224,4:102,5:20,8:8}
delta = 6 H1 + 2 H2 - 4 H3

old I = {4:26,5:2,6:18,7:50,8:99,9:213}
new I = {4:26,5:2,6:18,7:52,8:97,9:213}.
```

The local rank mass falls by 2, exactly matching the owned-width decrease.
Idle owner remainders are **not** included in this local invoice. Stock,
91 private buffers and 408 roles are fixed.

The only other solved-frame edit is restore 210, the sign change of source 96:
its frame moves from the old rank 8 hyperplane to FULL. Source 96 already reaches
FULL at restore 211. This moves the same rank 1 jump across a scalar sign change
and changes no paid histogram. No A or surviving B gate frame changes. The frozen
declared records include this edit rather than omitting it from provenance.

In the inherited sorted live-helper order,644 is role 389/native register 613;
660 is role 397/native register 621, for both gauge 44 and extra providers. These
are existing whole roles with reduced width, not deleted or fractional roles.

## Exact verification and finite precision scope

`verify.py` freshly executes both complete six-stage native runs: transport, residual
adapters, emitter, independent local replay, exact local phases, independent
warp recipe checks. All stages use the actual new words; no predecessor native
receipt substitutes for them. Each orientation has 632 arbitrary columns,
91 cleared buffers, 22,768 events and 17,449 scalar macros. Real-component
primitive bounds are 158,144 forward and 158,192 backward. The phase stage checks
all used local edges including global phase, and every warp recipe against
its exact 512-column Gaussian product.

The conservative fresh logical prefix reserves are 89 bits forward and 95 bits
backward, below the inherited local 128-bit reserve; the local auditor charges
192 payload bits. This finite logical prefix check does not establish a rounded recursive-child
precision contract. Global rounded precision and stopping exponents remain
separate caller obligations.

Negative controls omit a real release shear and regenerate cleanup; they still
fail the original targets (135/162 for 644,141/196 for 660). Flipping either real release coefficient also fails the target map. These
controls check the actual endpoint, independently of profile metadata. Declared reconstruction rejects
wrong scalar preimages and changed release coefficients. Wrapper controls above
separately exercise phase, entrance and paid-width binding.

`staged_pair.py` is a self-contained standard-library deterministic applier with
no frame optimizer. `STAGED-PAIR-RECORD-{base,extra}.json.gz` declares every edit
and solved frame preimage and regenerates inverse cleanup. Rebuilds reproduce
the complete decoded frozen word; `verify.py` checks semantic equality and
authenticates the immutable compressed inputs. Generated gzip headers and
streams are not used as a mathematical equality test. The earlier
PR3133 declared-edit review must still run on its own predecessorFINAL words;
these new records are a subsequent stage, not a replacement for that review.

## Remaining obligations and attribution

The construction alone does not provide changed-inventory fractional packing,
a chronological integral owner fill, all unused owner remainders, native owner
hosting, a complete block-norm context, rounded all-size recursive precision,
stopping exponent, finite-tape realization, or outer interval inequality. Those
must bind this exact pair of words and its new inventory. No κ follows here.

The word lineage and native/free-operator tools retain their source attributions:
PR2857's staged compensation kernels, PR2908/2917's paired/helper and native
interfaces, PR2979's joint word/inventory construction, and PR3133's coupled
carrier folds. The new staged incoming directions and their literal local
validation are established above; historical claims do not certify this word.
This package gives finite exact computation and the written linear identities,
not a formal-kernel theorem or an unconditional multiplication bound.
